name: handoff
title: Hand off {{params.session}} to {{params.name}}
description: The source agent writes a short handoff note; berth adds the diffstat, commits, the last check and the turn log (about 2 KB in all) and starts a new agent in a new worktree pointed at it. native forks or resumes the same vendor's own conversation instead.
tokens: The source agent gets one 170-character request. The new agent's first prompt is about 90 characters pointing at the packet file, which is capped at 2 KB plus file paths.

prompt.description: what to do next, added to the first prompt

native.description: fork or resume the source agent's own conversation (same vendor, same box)

steps.text: Write .berth/handoff/{{run.id}}.md for the agent taking over, at most 30 lines: Done, Left, Decisions, Gotchas. Paths, not code. Then stop.
Continue the work handed off to you. Read .berth/handoff/{{run.id}}.md first. {{params.prompt}}
